purpose: Meshy 6 text-guided 4K PBR Foundry proof on transform-baked padded Aegis Tortoise GA-003 UV authority

style.prompt: Hand-painted stylized PBR for a levitating low-poly Bulwark bot, readable at 41px. Large coherent regions, crisp boundaries. Medium-dark warm graphite armor, never black; ash-slate plates one value lighter; blackened steel only in recesses. Matte foundry lava-orange ceramic cassettes cover 10% of the body. Broad forged-brush variation, heat tempering, sparse chunky edge wear, satin-matte roughness, low-medium metalness. Clean albedo. No baked light, uniform gray, white/blue/cyan/green/red paint, rust, soot, micro-scratches, speckle, photoreal grime, chrome, gloss, text or logos. Preserve UVs.
